title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description:
Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2 of size m and n respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays.

The two arrays are individually sorted in non-decreasing order. You must return the median of all the values across both arrays combined.

The overall run time complexity should be O(log (m+n)).
approach: Binary-search the cut position in the shorter array; the cut in the other array follows from the required left-half size. A partition is valid when both left boundary values are at most the opposite right boundary values. The median then comes from the boundary maximum(s) and minimum(s). Each failed partition tells which direction to move. With m and n as the array lengths and m <= n, time is O(log m) and auxiliary space is O(1).
